summary: A single control sits alone on a flat warm off-white page (#f4f3ef), centred horizontally near the top third. At rest it is a 112 px circular search button: a white rim with a hairline grey edge and a soft diffuse drop shadow, holding a 90 px warm-grey disc (#ebe9e4) with a dark magnifier glyph. On click (0.45–1.0 s) the circle stretches symmetrically left and right into a 542 px pill search bar (x 237–779, top fixed at y 137) whose inner grey field shows the magnifier at left, a blue text caret, placeholder 'Search components' in light grey and a grey × at right; at the same time a white results panel (radius ~40 px, same width, soft shadow) drops from a thin pill under the bar down to y 610, and its four rows ('Action Button', 'Toast', 'Code Input', 'Segmented Control', ~27 px dark sans, 81 px pitch) slide/blur into place in a stagger, the first row covered by a fully rounded warm-grey highlight pill. From 1.6 to 3.2 s the cursor hovers down the list and the highlight pill glides (not jumps) between rows: Toast, Code Input, Segmented Control, then back to Action Button. At ~4.2 s typing 't' re-filters the list with a blurred cross-fade: matching letters turn bold black while the rest of each name goes mid-grey, and the panel grows to five rows (Toast, Tab Bar, Action Button, Quantity Stepper, Invite Field, bottom ~698); typing 'o' (~4.5 s) narrows it to three rows (Toast, Hold to Confirm, Action Button) and the panel shrinks to y ~528. Hovering the × shows a small round grey hover disc; clicking it (~6.0 s) clears the field and the original four rows blur back in (panel bottom back to 610). At ~7.05–7.25 s the panel retracts upward into the bar and the bar contracts back into the 112 px circle, ending where it began.

criteria.check: The page is a flat warm off-white (about #f4f3ef) with no gradient, texture or vignette
At rest a single circular search button is the only object on the page, centred horizontally (centre x≈509) with its top near y=137
The button is a circle about 112 px across (x≈453–565, y≈137–249)
The button is two-layer: a white outer ring about 10–11 px thick around a warm-grey (#ebe9e4) inner disc about 90 px across
The white ring has only a faint 1 px light-grey hairline edge and a soft diffuse shadow below it, not a dark or thick outline
A dark stroked magnifier (open circle with a short handle to the lower right, about 28 px) sits centred in the grey disc
The expanded bar spans about x 237–779 and y 137–249 (542 × 112 px), horizontally centred on the same axis as the circle
The bar is a fully rounded pill: a white shell with a hairline edge enclosing a warm-grey (#ebe9e4) pill field inset about 11 px on every side
Once expanded, the magnifier sits at the left of the field, centred near x≈292, y≈193
The field reads exactly 'Search components' in light grey (about #a8a7a3), roughly 27 px regular weight, starting near x≈334
A blue/violet vertical caret about 34 px tall sits just left of the placeholder's first letter
A mid-grey × (two thin strokes, about 21 px) sits at the right of the field near x≈723, y≈193
A results panel sits 15 px below the bar, spanning x 237–779 and y 263–610
The panel is near-white (#fdfdfd), lighter than the page, with corner radius about 40 px
The panel lifts off the page with a soft, wide, low-contrast shadow mostly below it, with no hard dark border
The panel lists exactly 4 rows
The rows read top to bottom 'Action Button', 'Toast', 'Code Input', 'Segmented Control'
Row labels are dark near-black (#1c1c1c) sans at about 27 px, left-aligned at x≈276
Rows are evenly pitched about 81 px apart (centres near y 316, 397, 478, 560)
The first row sits on a fully rounded warm-grey (#ebe9e4) pill about 520 × 80 px (x 248–768, y 275–355), inset ~11 px from the panel edge
Between 0.2 s and 1.3 s the circle widens symmetrically left and right into the pill bar (left edge moves ~216 px left, right edge ~214 px right) while its top stays at y≈137
Mid-expansion at 0.5 s the bar is an intermediate pill about 405 px wide (x≈305–711) with the placeholder clipped ('Search compor')
At 0.5 s the panel is only a thin white pill (~40 px tall, y≈263–303) under the bar and it grows downward to y≈610 by 1.0 s
Rows enter staggered: at 0.72 s the upper rows are nearly settled while 'Segmented Control' is still blurred and offset right, settling sharp by 1.3 s
Entering rows show a real Gaussian blur on the text (soft smeared glyphs), not just reduced opacity
The highlight pill moves from row 1 (Action Button) to row 2 (Toast) between 1.3 s and 1.9 s while the row labels stay still
The highlight glides continuously: at 2.15 s it sits between 'Toast' and 'Code Input' (y≈393–473), not snapping row to row
At 2.4 s the highlight sits on 'Code Input' (y≈440–520)
By 3.7 s the highlight has travelled back up to 'Action Button' (y≈275–355), passing over the rows between ~2.95 and 3.2 s
During the hover phase (1.3 s to 3.7 s) the bar and panel outlines do not move or resize
At 4.43 s the field shows the typed letter 't' in dark text with the caret after it, and the placeholder is gone
With 't' typed the rows read 'Toast', 'Tab Bar', 'Action Button', 'Quantity Stepper', 'Invite Field' (5 rows)
In each result only the matched 't'/'T' letter is bold black; the rest of the name is mid-grey
Typing 't' makes the panel grow downward from bottom y≈610 to y≈698 to fit five rows, top edge fixed
While re-filtering (4.2 s) the rows cross-fade: old names fade grey and blur/shift as new names move into place, no instant swap
By 5.5 s the field reads 'to'
With 'to' typed there are exactly 3 rows: 'Toast', 'Hold to Confirm', 'Action Button'
The matched 'To' in Toast, the word 'to' in Hold to Confirm and 'to' in Button are bold black; other letters are grey (~#7d7d7a)
With 'to' the panel bottom sits near y≈528, with the highlight pill still on row 1 ('Toast')
When hovered the × gains a round warm-grey hover disc (~64 px, slightly darker than the field) behind it
Clicking × clears the query: between 5.5 s and 6.6 s the field returns to the grey 'Search components' placeholder and the list returns to the original 4 rows with panel bottom back at y≈610
At 7.1 s the panel is retracting upward (only ~120 px tall, y≈263–384) with its remaining row label blurred
Between 7.1 s and 7.4 s the pill bar contracts back into a ~108–112 px circle centred near x≈509 and the panel is gone entirely
The loop ends where it began: the 7.4 s frame matches the 0.2 s frame (single circle button, magnifier only, no panel)
The bar's widening and the panel's downward drop happen together in one ~0.55 s move (0.45–1.0 s), not one after the other
